payoff_milestone: RIVA 128 (Direct3D triangles) puts NVIDIA back on the map
notes: NV1 (1995) used its own quadratic-surface 3D method; Direct3D standardised on triangles; RIVA 128 shipped in 1H 1997. Start = NV1 launch year (month approximate); end = RIVA 128 launch half-year.

bet: GeForce 256 marketed as the first GPU
notes: GeForce 256 launched 1999 with hardware transform and lighting; FY2002 revenue $1.37B. Start month approximate.

payoff_milestone: Xbox reaches 23% of FY2003 revenue as gross margin falls to 30%
notes: Agreement 2000-03-05; $200M advance against purchases (April 2000). Revenue scale-up at lower margin. cost_usd_b here is the advance received (cash in) not a cost.

payoff_milestone: Data Center revenue first exceeds total R&D (FY2018)
notes: CUDA announced with G80 2006-11-08; FY2018 Data Center $1.93B vs R&D $1.80B. Cost = CS2's ~$2.8B estimate of R&D above the FY2008 intensity over FY2009–FY2015 (repo estimate).

payoff_milestone: Icera modem business wound down; NVIDIA exits phone basebands
notes: Icera bought for ~$367M (Reuters: $352.2M at completion); $100–125M restructuring charge expected if unsold.

payoff_milestone: GB200 NVL72 makes the 72-GPU rack the unit of sale
notes: DGX-1 unveiled 2016-04-05 at $129K; GB200 NVL72 first volume shipments CY2024-Q4.

payoff_milestone: Q2 FY2024: Data Center revenue $10.3B (+141% q/q) as Hopper meets ChatGPT
notes: V100 announced GTC 2017; Q2 FY2024 Data Center revenue $10.32B vs $4.28B in Q1 FY2024.

payoff_milestone: Cumulative networking gross profit passes the $6.9B price (half-credit scenario)
notes: Payback date from CS1 repo model (half of networking credited to Mellanox at 65% gross margin); announced 2019-03-11.

payoff_milestone: Deal terminated after regulatory opposition; ~$1.36B charge
notes: Announced 2020-09-13; terminated 2022-02-08; NVIDIA kept a 20-year Arm licence.

payoff_milestone: GB200 NVL72 ships with 36 Grace CPUs per rack
notes: Grace announced 2021-04-12 with licensed Arm Neoverse cores.

payoff_milestone: Groq 3 LPX rack in full production
notes: Non-exclusive licence plus founder and team hire; ~$20B reported; LPX full production announced 2026-08-24; revenue not yet disclosed.

payoff_milestone: Close targeted H1 2027 subject to review
notes: ~$11.9B to investors plus up to $1B stock incentives; possible EU review and DOJ interest. End date = end of the targeted closing window.
